utilities.user_request: how do I get Shelly working

docs.title: Shelly
docs.text: Shelly devices are discovered over mDNS when on the same subnet. Gen 1 devices use CoIoT, which must be enabled in the device's own web UI and pointed at the Home Assistant IP, or state updates will lag. Gen 2 and later use RPC over WebSocket and need no extra setup.

docs.title: Philips Hue
docs.text: The Hue bridge is discovered automatically. Press the physical link button on the bridge within 30 seconds of starting the config flow to authorise Home Assistant. The bridge issues an API key that is stored in the config entry.

docs.title: Zigbee Home Automation
docs.text: ZHA is added from Settings > Devices & Services and auto-discovers most supported coordinators. Choose the radio type (EZSP for Silicon Labs, zn p for Texas Instruments) and the serial port. Keep the coordinator on a USB extension cable away from the host, since USB 3 ports emit interference in the 2.4 GHz band.

RELEVANT DOCS:
  [shelly-setup] Shelly — Adding a device
      Shelly devices are discovered over mDNS when on the same subnet. Gen 1 devices use CoIoT, which must be enabled in the device's own web UI and pointed at the Home Assistant IP, or state updates will lag. Gen 2 and later use RPC over WebSocket and need no extra setup.
  [hue-setup] Philips Hue — Bridge pairing
      The Hue bridge is discovered automatically. Press the physical link button on the bridge within 30 seconds of starting the config flow to authorise Home Assistant. The bridge issues an API key that is stored in the config entry.
  [zha-setup] Zigbee Home Automation — Adding the integration
      ZHA is added from Settings > Devices & Services and auto-discovers most supported coordinators. Choose the radio type (EZSP for Silicon Labs, zn p for Texas Instruments) and the serial port. Keep the coordinator on a USB extension cable away from the host, since USB 3 ports emit interference in the 2.4 GHz band.
